svg.aria-label: Skills from MLBB: Analytical Intelligence - Reading the data fast and fixing root causes, not symptoms.; Situational Awareness - Spotting risks early across code, deadlines, and production.; Map Awareness - Keeping the whole system in view while working on one part.; Micro & Macro - Clean details in the code, smart strategy in the architecture.; Counter & Re-counter - Weighing trade-offs between tools, patterns, and approaches.; Draft Picking - Choosing the right tech stack for the problem and the team.; META Awareness - Staying current as tools and best practices keep shifting.; Shotcalling & Leadership - Clear calls, owning decisions, and lifting the team up.
